title: KedgeFlow v0.9 proposed KF-JSON-0.2 record profile
description: Closed signed record envelopes. This proposal is not an adopted industry standard. Validation is necessary but does not authenticate, authorize, canonicalize, establish truth, or provide transactional guarantees.

JwkThumbprint.description: Unpadded base64url SHA-256 RFC7638 public-JWK thumbprint.

SpiffeId.description: SPIFFE workload identity; apply the SPIFFE ID specification's further path and trust-domain validation.

Time.description: UTC milliseconds since Unix epoch; JSON safe integer.

JsonValue.description: Application data extension boundary. Numbers are safe integers; decimal quantities use schema-defined strings. A registered closed parameter/result schema MUST also validate this value.

Parameters.description: Exact resolved parameters; independently validate against the registered action parameter schema. Unknown privileged defaults are forbidden.

SubjectIdentity.description: Human identity is the OIDC issuer/subject pair, never sub alone or an email display name.

DelegationBinding.description: Reference to an OAuth user-delegation access token bound through cnf.jkt to a validated DPoP proof key. An OIDC ID token is not a delegation token. The signed proposal binds the body independently of DPoP.

Proposal.description: Frozen candidate request q. A proposal conveys no execution authority.

PredicateDescriptor.description: Conjunction over the declared resource scope. Empty conjunction provides no state-invariant protection; unsupported clauses MUST fail closed.

IdempotencyContract.description: Idempotency is orthogonal to consequence tier, guard level, and completion semantics.

AdapterContract.description: Level A atomicity applies only to guard_scope and covered mutation paths; local SQL CAS cannot make downstream Kubernetes execution atomic.

BudgetReference.description: Atomic allocation debit in the parent composite budget. Delegation must not copy an allowance into another root.

AdmissionCertificate.description: All obligations satisfied under bound policy/evidence/state; certificate is not a grant.

ExecutionGrant.description: Action-bound, audience-bound, dual-identity-bound authority. Atomic ledger claim and resource-side guards are still mandatory.

RenderingContract.description: Immutable registry template rendering only validated canonical parameters; natural-language agent summaries cannot substitute for this view.

CompensationDescriptor.description: A separately admitted compensating operation. This is not a guarantee of an inverse or automatic physical rollback. Unknown effects require reconciliation before compensation.

ConsequentialToolDescriptor.description: Proposed CTD v1.0 classification. A consequence-tier label is not a safety, idempotency, guard, or completeness guarantee. Inline parameter_schema is separately validated as JSON Schema Draft 2020-12.

ApprovalPayload.description: Server constructs this exact payload. WebAuthn challenge is base64url(SHA256(JCS(payload))); authenticator signs authData plus SHA256(clientDataJSON), not this JSON directly.

AuthenticatorPolicy.description: User verification alone does not establish hardware binding; verifier applies approved enrollment/attestation policy.

HitlWitness.description: Provider-signed verified assertion record W_hitl. Subject is the reviewer and must equal approval.reviewer. Admission verifies provider trust and exact q/policy/rendering bindings. Fixture provider is an offline test emulator, not evidence of a hardware ceremony.

AdmissionLease.description: Provisional static validation only; leases neither reserve target capacity nor authorize execution.

SagaExecutionRoot.description: Parent composite authority ledger root. Per-node child effect roots and forward/compensation allocations conserve budget; DAG acyclicity, sums, and atomic transitions are semantic checks.

RemediationContract.description: KedgeFlow deployment convention inside MCP JSON-RPC error.data for application code -32001; it is not an MCP-standard grant extension.

DelegationRequest.description: delegate(gid, childCertificate) attenuation request. A single-action transfer retires parent allowance; a saga child requires an atomic existing composite allocation.

TokenExchangeBinding.description: Auditable token-exchange request/response binding, not a raw credential store. RFC8693 form-urlencoded wire request contains token values resolved from gateway vault references, never copied to agents. STS must enforce local G attenuation; native AWS/DB credentials require provider-specific brokers.

A2ARootReference.description: Proposed A2A v1.0 DataPart.data extension. Non-bearer ledger reference; receiver still authenticates, admits, and obtains attenuated child authority.
